title: Tim and Faith Rooftop - Amazing Nashville Hangout
description:
Over 800sqft Rooftop with stunning views of the Nashville skyline. Enjoy fun and games at your rooftop bar, the big screen tv, Corn Hole, Ping Pong & more. The sunsets are simply incredible!!

The converted garage features a pool table, ample seating, ambient lighting & a flat screen TV.

Just mins from East Nashville Bars & Restaurants. 10 Minute Uber to Downtown Honky Tonks!

We have other identical properties in this community. If you don't see availability for your desired dates.

The space
With 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, an amazing kitchen with island seating for 4 people  & everything you need for cooking including gas cooktop & griddle, this home will not disappoint.

This musically themed property showcases incredible custom decorations, desk seating, a stunning mural of Tim & Faith performing together, and even recording equipment that can be rented for a nominal fee should you find yourself visiting Nashville to write songs with friends!

With so much to do within the home and an abundance of beds to accommodate your group, it's time to enjoy your stay not just while out sight seeing but when you get home and kick your shoes off too...

It's always nice to break down the bedding arrangement to make it easier to understand what the property holds, so here it is:

Bedroom 1 - King Bed + 2x Single roll-out trundle bed underneath
Bedroom 2 - King Bed + Single roll-out trundle bed underneath
Bedroom 3 - Single Day Bed + Single roll-out trundle underneath
Bedroom 4 - 2x Single Beds + 2x Single roll-out trundles underneath
Landing area with mural - Futon

Located minutes from all of East Nashville’s hot spots and just a 10 minute Uber from Downtown Nashville, the location is just perfect for your base while enjoying everything Music City has to offer.

'Tim & Faith's Rooftop' is a new construction property as of late 2021. Be sure to see the reviews on our other homes while we build our guest and fan base for this little beauty!

With the garage converted to our feature games room, parking is limited to approximately 14 guest spots for the entire 50 home community and on street parking on Cherokee is also limited . Parking is also prohibited in front of the garages. Violators may be towed. Please consider traveling to and from the airport with ride share such as Uber & Lyft.

Our hope is you choose to stay with us on your first visit to Nashville and then we become the ‘go to’ place to re-book for all your future trips!

The owner is willing to consider pets on a case by case basis for an additional fee. Please inquire with us about the additional fee and approval if you are considering traveling with your furry friends.

We look forward to welcoming you...
